text:
The Nifty 50 edged up 0.06% to 25,044.65, while the broader Nifty 500 rose 0.47% to 23,567.0, indicating a modest but positive move across the market. Advances outpaced declines (314 vs 174) and the breadth score stayed in the “HEALTHY” zone at 71.8, showing the rally was fairly broad‑based. The India VIX fell to 17.42, suggesting lower volatility after a 12.39% rise over the past five days.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers of about ₹7,212 crore today, extending a nine‑day buying streak, while Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold roughly ₹7,173 crore, marking a seven‑day net outflow. The top gainers included DATAPATTNS and IREDA, whereas RRKABEL and TDPOWERSYS led the losers. In the sector quadrants, “Leading” stocks such as Pharma, Private Bank and Financial Services drove the market, while “Weakening” areas like IT and Oil & Gas lagged. Options data show a Nifty PCR of 1.07 and a max‑pain level at 25,000, with the expected range of 25,040‑25,049 and a call wall at 26,000, indicating modest bullish bias.

Watch the Nifty 50 pivot levels: support at 24,894.25 (S1) and resistance at 25,139.55 (R1). Bank Nifty’s key levels are 59,165.65 (S1) and 60,029.05 (R1). Next session attention should be on USD‑INR near 93.92, Brent crude slipping to $93.92, and any news on RBI policy or global earnings that could shift sentiment. Keep an eye on the 5‑day trends – Nifty 50 up 6.84% and Bank Nifty up 8.62% – for clues on whether the current rally can sustain.
